purpose: Cycle 23 M3: measure what each of the three candidate fixes for the unbreedable bootstrap elites COSTS in coverage, against a measured control, with refusal first-class — L1's named fix, deliberately not taken there because it trades against the coverage DR 0042 adopted.
closed_states: the three candidate fixes are separated and measured independently — never blended into one 'fix'
the coverage bar is the loop's own MEASURED seed-to-seed variation, not a constant
G1 is structural (exactly zero refusals), derived from L1's measured mechanism rather than picked as a percentage
the SLIP predicate is the generation arm's own, imported and never re-implemented, so no arm can admit a creature the generator would refuse
every arm's coverage cost is reported, including refused arms — a refused arm's cost is the evidence for refusing it
blocked_states: this module ADOPTS NOTHING: it measures the arms and applies the rule. Changing the loop's default is a decision record's job, and the incumbent stays runnable and byte-identical when the arm is off
one seed per arm against a two-seed control; a distributional claim about any arm's cost needs E4's ten-seed protocol

the arms are measured under ONE SLIP profile (slip_lcd_seed). A profile with a wider palette would reject fewer bootstrap creatures and could change every cost here — the numbers are this covenant's, not the mechanism's in general
coverage and QD are incumbent-geometry numbers (DR 0046's comparability rule): they may not be read against reachability or support counts, which live in the probe geometry

decision.rule: pre-registered (cycle 23 M3), refusal first-class: an arm is ADOPTABLE only if it passes BOTH gates. G1 — the cause is eliminated: refusals == exactly zero, a STRUCTURAL bar because L1 proved 100% of refusals are SLIP-illegal parents, so removing the cause must reach zero (a percentage-reduction bar would be a number nobody derived). G2 — coverage is preserved: the arm's coverage cost must not exceed the MEASURED coverage control, the loop's own seed-to-seed variation measured by running the incumbent at two seeds, never a constant; a coverage GAIN is never penalised. Among passing arms the winner is the least invasive (parents < insertion < bootstrap), fixed before the run. This module adopts nothing: changing the loop's default is a decision record's job.
